fact: At 31 December 2025, 362,818 households (2,220,500 people) were enrolled in the RSU, deployed in 10 regions, 20 provinces and 99 communes, with 252 communes still to cover by 2028.
title: Secrétariat technique du Registre social unique: mise à jour sur le RSU
publisher: Secrétariat technique du Registre social unique, Ministère de la Famille et de la Solidarité
